details.description: Dark mode state is toggled but never applied to the UI. The container div always has 'bg-white text-black' regardless of the darkMode state.
details.fix_explanation: Applied conditional className based on darkMode state. Updated container to use ternary operator for background and text colors with transition effect.
details.after: <div className={`min-h-screen w-full p-4 transition-colors duration-300 ${darkMode ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white' : 'bg-white text-black'}`}>

details.description: Using 'w-screen h-screen' (fixed screen height) prevents responsive layout. Content cannot scroll and restricts vertical space.
details.fix_explanation: Changed 'h-screen' to 'min-h-screen' to allow content to expand beyond viewport. Removed 'w-screen' in favor of 'w-full' for better responsiveness.

details.description: Grid columns are hardcoded to 3 ('grid-cols-3'), which doesn't adapt to mobile screens causing layout breaking.
details.fix_explanation: Implemented responsive grid with Tailwind breakpoints: grid-cols-1 (mobile), sm:grid-cols-2 (tablet), lg:grid-cols-3 (desktop).

details.description: Using array index as React key (key={i}) is an anti-pattern that can cause rendering issues if metrics are reordered or updated.
details.fix_explanation: Changed to use unique identifier based on metric data: key={`${m.label}-${m.value}`} for stable reference.

details.description: No loading state feedback. User doesn't know data is being loaded during the 1-second delay.
details.fix_explanation: Added 'isLoading' state. Display loading message while data loads. Hide metrics grid until data arrives. Show loading UI with conditional rendering.

details.description: Button has minimal styling and no visual feedback (no hover states, poor contrast, minimal padding).
details.fix_explanation: Enhanced button with proper colors, hover states, rounded corners, increased padding, font weight, and dark mode aware colors.
details.before:
<button
        className="mb-4 px-2 py-1 border"
        onClick={() => setDarkMode(!darkMode)}
      >
        Toggle Dark Mode
      </button>
details.after:
<button
        className={`mb-6 px-4 py-2 rounded font-medium transition-colors ${
          darkMode
            ? "bg-yellow-500 text-black hover:bg-yellow-600"
            : "bg-blue-500 text-white hover:bg-blue-600"
        }`}
        onClick={() => setDarkMode(!darkMode)}
      >
        Toggle Dark Mode
      </button>

details.description: Metric cards lack proper styling and visual hierarchy. Missing padding, rounded corners, and dark mode support.
details.fix_explanation: Added rounded corners, improved padding, conditional background colors for dark mode, borders that adapt to theme, and formatted number display.
details.after:
{m.label}
{m.value.toLocaleString()}
